profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Empower AI | Enterprise .NET & Angular | CMS Healthcare Systems | Azure DevOps | Application Modernization
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 14+ years of experience building, modernizing, deploying, and supporting mission-critical enterprise healthcare applications for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

Throughout my career at Empower AI, I have contributed to multiple national CMS initiatives including CERT (Comprehensive Error Rate Testing), PERM (Payment Error Rate Measurement), and ZPIC/UPIC, delivering secure and scalable applications that support healthcare payment integrity, medical claim review, and program integrity.

My experience spans the full software development lifecycle, from designing and developing enterprise applications to production support, DevOps, application modernization, release engineering, and system integration. I enjoy solving complex technical problems, improving system reliability, and taking ownership of critical applications throughout their lifecycle.

Over the years I have worked across a broad range of technologies including C#, .NET Framework, .NET 8, ASP.NET MVC/Core, Angular, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework, Azure DevOps, Git, Docker, IIS, ADFS, Datadog, CI/CD, and enterprise security. My work has also included application performance monitoring, production troubleshooting, architecture documentation, workflow analysis, security compliance, and deployment automation.

I enjoy understanding complex systems end-to-end, mentoring team members, documenting technical knowledge, and continuously learning modern technologies. I am currently expanding my expertise in cloud-native architectures and AI-powered software development while continuing to build reliable enterprise solutions.
